The complete upstream statement is preserved in README.upstream.md. No standard open-source license was supplied.
Nozoki integration: original SVG and extracted upstream stylesheet are unchanged, isolated in a same-origin local iframe. player.html, player.css and player.js provide only the embedding bridge. Application code controls resource readiness, paused animation clocks, entry/exit completion and cleanup. No replacement artwork is drawn.
